snippet.title: Union Max - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Union Max is the latest Visual Novel project from BLits Games! 

Union Max is a Gay Adult / Yaoi Visual Novel that features the adventures of Max, the unlikely hero chosen to become the next ‘Light of the Kosmos'! Join Max on his journey across the Realms of the Kosmos, gathering the sparks of Romance, Desire, Angst and Happiness. Reclaim the lost sparks – together as one!

Wishlist now on Steam, or Pre-order your copy on the BLits website!

Follow our website, newsletter and more for more info!
